程序包 org.bukkit.help

接口 HelpMap

public interface HelpMap
The HelpMap tracks all help topics registered in a Bukkit server. When the server starts up or is reloaded, help is processed and topics are added in the following order:
  1. General topics are loaded from the help.yml
  2. Plugins load and optionally call addTopic()
  3. Registered plugin commands are processed by HelpTopicFactory objects to create topics
  4. Topic contents are amended as directed in help.yml
HelpMap 会追踪 Bukkit 服务器中注册的所有帮助主题。当服务器启动或重载时，帮助会被处理，主题按以下顺序添加：

  1. 从 help.yml 加载通用主题
  2. 插件加载并可选地调用 addTopic()
  3. 已注册的插件命令由 HelpTopicFactory 对象处理以创建主题
  4. 按照 help.yml 的指示修订主题内容

    • getHelpTopic

      HelpTopic getHelpTopic(String topicName)
      Returns a help topic for a given topic name.
      参数:
      topicName - The help topic name to look up. 要查找的帮助主题名称。
      返回:
      A HelpTopic object matching the topic name or null if 与主题名称匹配的 HelpTopic 对象，若找不到则为 null。 none can be found.

    • addTopic

      void clear()

    • registerHelpTopicFactory

      void registerHelpTopicFactory(Class<?> commandClass, HelpTopicFactory<?> factory)
      Associates a HelpTopicFactory object with given command base class. Plugins typically call this method during onLoad(). Once registered, the custom HelpTopicFactory will be used to create a custom HelpTopic for all commands deriving from the commandClass base class, or all commands deriving from PluginCommand who's executor derives from commandClass base class. 将一个 HelpTopicFactory 对象与给定的命令基类关联。插件通常在 onLoad() 期间调用此方法。注册后，自定义 HelpTopicFactory 将用于为所有派生自 commandClass 基类的命令，以及所有派生自 PluginCommand 且其执行器派生自 commandClass 基类的命令，创建自定义 HelpTopic。
      参数:
      commandClass - The class for which the custom HelpTopicFactory 自定义 HelpTopicFactory 所适用的类。必须派生自 Command 或 CommandExecutor。 applies. Must derive from either Command or CommandExecutor.
      factory - The HelpTopicFactory implementation to associate 要与 commandClass 关联的 HelpTopicFactory 实现。 with the commandClass.
      抛出:
      IllegalArgumentException - Thrown if commandClass does 当 commandClass 不是派生自合法基类时抛出。 not derive from a legal base class.

    • getIgnoredPlugins

      List<String> getIgnoredPlugins()
      Gets the list of plugins the server administrator has chosen to exclude from the help index. Plugin authors who choose to directly extend Command instead of PluginCommand will need to check this collection in their HelpTopicFactory implementations to ensure they meet the server administrator's expectations. 获取服务器管理员选择从帮助索引中排除的插件列表。选择直接继承 Command 而非 PluginCommand 的插件作者，需要在其 HelpTopicFactory 实现中检查此集合，以确保符合服务器管理员的期望。
      返回:
      A list of plugins that should be excluded from the help index. 应从帮助索引中排除的插件列表。
